title: Design System: River Crossing Family Dental

label.purpose: Small uppercase line above a heading.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Color and shadow transitions on buttons and cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The coral pill for the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e07856; color: #fff; font: 700 14px/1 Geist, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(15, 31, 51, 0.12); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c8633f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2c4a6b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Navy outline for the second action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 32px; border: 2px solid #2c4a6b; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #2c4a6b; font: 600 14px/1 Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2c4a6b; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2c4a6b; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Card
components.description: Cream card for a peer point on a white band.
components.html:
Comfortable care

Plain words about what to expect.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f7f3ec; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #2c4a6b; font: 700 20px/1.3 Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #334155; font: 400 16px/1.6 Geist, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Cream paper, navy type, and coral only for the action. Pages alternate cream and white. Photography is real and rounded. Copy is warm and short.
keyCharacteristics: Coral is the one action color
Buttons are 48px pills and full width on a phone

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Coral fills the button that should be tapped. A second action is a navy outline.

rules.name: The Same Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the same type sizes as the rest of the site.

rules.name: The Flat Band Rule
rules.body: A section band is flat. Shadow belongs to the photo or card inside it.

dos: Do alternate cream and white bands.
Do show a published price as a large number, then the name, then the limit.
donts: Don't add a new typeface or accent color.
Don't stack several identical card grids down one page.
Don't crop a landscape photo into a tall portrait frame.
